versions.changelog:
- Initial release of podcast-chat-prep: a batch processing tool for podcast transcripts.
- Core features include per-episode notes, guest opinion tracking across episodes, personality profiling, chat material library, and content extraction for social use.
- Supports transcripts from .md/.txt files generated by various ASR tools, suitable for multi-host, conversational podcasts.
- Outputs structured files including episode summaries, opinion evolution timelines, guest profiles, topic indexes, chat materials, and public account content drafts.
- Designed for users who want deep podcast insights or fast-track conversational know-how without listening to every episode.
